layers.name: Canonical price construction
layers.transformation: backward cumulative product of later split factors (five implementations, identical geometry; deterministic check in this audit)

layers.name: Total-return calculation
files: quant/engines/canonical-total-return.js:183-262 (1.0.0 on main and in the tournament freeze)
layers.input: raw close, splitFactor, dividend, provider adjClose (cross-check)
layers.transformation: g_t = s_t (close_t + D_t) / close_{t-1}; backward-normalised index; cross-check blocks SPLIT_MISSING/DIVIDEND_MISSING
failureModes: raw-only SPLIT_SUSPECTED check runs only when no provider adjClose exists (lines 220-229): an undeclared split missing from both provider columns passes as a market move
layers.usedBy: Quant studies (daily-prices.mjs), Supertrader research tournament (data.mjs firstCanonicalFailure), Vorsorge TR
